summary: Initializes an object's vtable pointer at this+0x0 to the vtable at off_5B9BCC and returns this. Unconditional write; second parameter a2 is unused.

local_names.this: object pointer whose vtable slot (offset 0x0) is set

operations.description: Write vtable address off_5B9BCC into the object's vtable pointer at this+0x0.

unresolved: Purpose and value of unused second parameter a2 (possibly a hidden ownership or alignment flag) is unknown.
